comment: Shared hub stream-limit contract table. stream_limit_bytes pins the frame-size cap that the Go constant hubframe.StreamLimit and the Python _HUB_STREAM_LIMIT (plugins/platforms/discord/hub_client.py) must both equal. The frames table drives the Go ReadFrame tests: content_bytes is the frame length before the terminating newline. The Python contract test (tests/plugins/platforms/discord/test_hubframe_contract.py) reads this file so Python == table == Go.
